lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of circular high-luminance blobs are visible across the mid-lateral flank, with individual centroids spaced semi-uniformly. The most distinct clusters are located in the region dorsal to the pectoral fin and posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a subtle grid-like appearance where the spots serve as anchor nodes within the vertical-horizontal matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high pixel intensity on the superior edge and a defined shadow gradient on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial density of small high-luminance spots, with a notable increase in concentration toward the leading edge and distal tip.
